<!--
In the repo where it went wrong:

    node tools/artgen/artgen.js report <id> --note "what is wrong"      (artgen-maps.js in a maps-only install)

Read the folder it writes (art/feedback/<date>-<id>/), then paste the content of ISSUE.md below this comment.
If the input file was too large to paste, drag it from that folder into this issue.
`artgen report <id> --issue` does this for you when GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN is set.
Nothing outside the folder is sent. Delete anything you don't want to share before you post.
-->
